items.title: Why a Data Center Slowdown Benefits Big Tech
items.summary: Conventional wisdom said a Democratic sweep would be bad for data centers, and chips and neoclouds sold off accordingly. But Big Tech added a trillion dollars in a day, and a more nuanced read is emerging: a policy-driven slowdown may give the hyperscalers cover to trim CapEx and let the AI bubble deflate instead of pop. Plus ChatGPT's search share, OpenAI's ads, Apple's shrinking AI budgets, and the coming AI pause debate.
items.whyItMatters: Infrastructure news is the supply side of AI: chips, memory, and hosting constraints quietly decide what tools can exist and what they cost.
